title: Contact American Education and Translation Services (AET)
description: Choose one AET office to request translation, credential evaluation, interpretation, or notary services.
introHeading: Please CONTACT ONLY ONE OFFICE below to avoid delays. You have two options:

options.title: Email
options.body: Opt 1. Email: Send a scanned copy of your document to one of our offices via email. We will reply with the quote and time ASAP. The original documents aren't needed for certified translation and foreign credential evaluation. Phone call is not necessary.

options.title: Visit
options.body: Opt 2. Visit our office with your document. A reservation is required for the San Francisco office; other offices do not require an appointment.
